title: We toured with Xavier. ...
text: We toured with Xavier.  He was so knowledgeable and fun, it made our day a wonderful experience. We definitely would recommend to anyone new to Barcelona!
author: Thomas_M

title: La Sagrada and Park Guell
text: Our guide, Xavier, was excellent!  Very informative and personable. We saw many of the notti miss sites in Bar Alina in 7 hours.
author: Sue_W

title: Don’t miss out on LSF
text: 2 options for this tour    Half or full day tour.   Since this is our second trip to Barcelona within 18 months my husband and I chose the half day tour with the entry ticket to La Sagrada Família    Our tour guide was Rod and he was fantastic.  He shared a wealth of information of Spain and Barcelona and engaged tourists to keep us focused.  We highly recommend this tour and the visit to La Sagrada Família. author: Susan_H

title: Awesome Experience!!
text: Our tour guide Mel was fantastic. She was very knowledgeable about the sites and gave us a great explanation of what was behind the scenes.
author: Rick_S

title: Wow! What an amazing way to get a snapshot of Barcelona
text: Sergio was our Tour Guide.  He was highly articulate guiding the 6 of us while tailoring his comments for a diverse group.  Half way through the tour we experienced a seriously flat tire.  Sergio didn't blink, made alternative  arrangements, and the tour continued with minimal delay.   Oh, and the sights we saw were breathtaking and his comments provided context that made the experience even more enjoyable.  I would note that materials Sergio used were helpful in providing historical perspective and his English skills were superb.
author: Kathryn_C

title: Fantastic and informative
text:
A fantastic tour with an excellent guide, Rodrigue (Rod). He mastered Catalan and Spanish history and made us laugh with his historical anecdotes. This activity is an absolute must-do to understand the history of the Catalans and the details of the construction of the Sagrada Familia over time.
Thanks Tod for this superb day
author: Curiosity660104

title: Amazing guide
text: Sergei was incredible and very knowledgeable! Highly recommend this tour. The Gaudi architecture was incredible and it was amazing to learn
author: Lexi_G

title: Very nice visits
text: Excursion very well organized. Rodriguez our guide was excellent, very knowledgeable and generous of his time and relevant comments. He is also very friendly. We loved our half day and recommend this company.
author: lyetted

title: Wonderful and educational
text: This is a must do tour in Barcelona.   You can see all the major sites.  And is a guided tour inside both Sagrada Familia and Park Guell.  Rod was an amazing guide and answered all of our questions.   Must be able to do a lot of walking but was an absolute wonderful experience.
author: Scenic40024385920

title: Sergio was AMAZING
text: Sergio was an absolutely awesome tour guide - so incredibly well versed in the small alleys and big picture of the basillica.  He knows more than most could hope to learn and I'd take his tour again in a hearr beat
